target_source_rule: The minimum reward-fate probability, minimum transfer-fate probability and maximum source-misclassification rate must be justified from assay validation, biological relevance, theory, or independent prior information. Stage-0 focal fate proportions must not be used to choose convenient thresholds; Stage-0 supplies nuisance quantities only and threshold justification must be independent of the focal fate partition.

primary_estimand.name: same_visit_source_resolved_pollen_fate_partition
primary_estimand.reward_fate: source-resolved focal pollen recovered in preregistered groomed/collected reward compartments at the standardized scoring time
primary_estimand.transfer_fate: source-resolved focal pollen deposited on a conspecific recipient stigma or retained in preregistered transfer-associated visitor-body sectors at the standardized scoring time
primary_estimand.unresolved_or_lost_fate: tracked separately and never silently reassigned

precision_stopping_rule.final_scale_rule: Choose a design that reaches the registered target power/precision for both fate lower-bound criteria simultaneously across the frozen nuisance sensitivity range while preserving plant-level clustering.

fail_closed_rules: Do not run final power while any REQUIRED_BEFORE_USE field remains.
Do not use Stage-0 reward or transfer fate proportions to define the biological floors.
Do not call NO_DEMONSTRATED_CONFLICT because one fate fails significance or precision; failure to meet the positive contract remains UNRESOLVED.
Do not pool unassigned/lost pollen into either reward or transfer fate.
Do not treat pollen grains, body sectors, recipient stigmas or visits from the same plant as independent biological replicates.
Do not close the gate with pollen extraction plus stigma contact unless focal pollen is source-resolved into the registered competing fates.
